trial_title: Prognostic Value of Carotid CEUS in Acute Ischemic Stroke Patients
brief_summary: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound(CEUS) of carotid artery plaque is a novel method that enabled direct visualization of neovessels in the vulnerable plaque. Plaque enhancement with CEUS showed correlation with the histologic density of neovessels within the carotid plaque and the previous cardiovascular events.
